description:
`docker run --rm ghcr.io/percolisp/pcl -E 'say 6*7'` should be the cheapest way
to try PCL.

=== DONE (s481a) ===

Dockerfile at the repo root.  The recipe is NOT restated: the dependency layer
is tools/install-matrix/deps.sh (the script the install matrix and
tools/t/install-container.t already run) and the install is tools/install-pcl,
which self-verifies -- so a successful build is already a working PCL and cannot
drift from what CI proves installable.  /opt/pcl, non-root user `pcl`,
WORKDIR /work, ENTRYPOINT ["pcl"].  tools/install-matrix/Dockerfile stays where
it is and answers the per-distro question.

.dockerignore keeps ~/.pcl-cache, .faillog, agent worktrees and a 50 MB
pcl.core out of the context.  Because it also excludes .git (large, changes
every commit), tools/install-pcl would fall back to CHANGELOG.md and the image
would call itself "Unreleased" -- hence the PCL_VERSION build arg, which the
release workflow fills with the tag (verified: --build-arg PCL_VERSION=v0.1.0-test
made `pcl --version` print it).

.github/workflows/container.yml: ghcr.io/percolisp/pcl on a `v*` tag push and on
workflow_dispatch, authenticated by the job's own GITHUB_TOKEN
(permissions: packages: write).  Nothing for the USER to configure except making
the package public ONCE after the first run.  The image is smoke-tested BEFORE
the push.

MEASURED: podman build 38.8 s, 468 MB; `-E 'say 6*7'` -> 42; the README
example program under -v "$PWD":/work prints its six lines byte-identical to
`perl demo.pl`; --entrypoint pl2cl prints the Lisp.  The workflow's shell steps
were simulated end to end with podman (everything but the login and the push).
All three workflows re-parse as YAML.

NOT PUBLISHED: the first ghcr.io push happens with the next release tag.  The
README says so in one sentence.

KNOWN CONTAINER BEHAVIOUR, not a PCL bug: the image's non-root user cannot read
a bind-mounted directory that is mode 0700 under rootless podman
(--userns=keep-id does not help while the image sets USER).  An ordinary 0755
working directory, and a GitHub runner workspace, are fine -- both probed.
subject: P1(c): a container image -- root Dockerfile + .dockerignore + .github/workflows/container.yml pushing ghcr.io/percolisp/pcl on a v* tag; built and run locally, NOT yet published
